title: Dynamo: Amazon's Highly Available Key-value Store
summary: Introduces a fully distributed key-value store with tunable consistency, consistent hashing, and vector clocks.

title: Attention Is All You Need
summary: The foundational Transformer paper. Replaced recurrence with self-attention for sequence modeling.

title: Raft: In Search of an Understandable Consensus Algorithm
summary: Presents Raft, a consensus algorithm designed for understandability, equivalent to Paxos in fault-tolerance.

title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition

title: The CAP FAQ
summary: A concise FAQ explaining the CAP theorem, its implications, and common misconceptions.
